data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic elements haimaz (striving, war) and rih (power, ruler), Heinrike means 'struggle, warrior woman'. This name was popular among medieval Germanic and Slavic cultures and is associated with strength and determination. The name Heinrike carries the meaning “Struggle, warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Heinrike usually hope their child will grow to embody struggle, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: A woman whose name means 'gracious' or 'merciful'. Derived from the Hebrew root חנך (חנך, chanak), meaning 'to educate, to train'. This name is a compound of the Hebrew words חנך (hanak) and רך (rik), meaning 'grace' and 'strength' or 'might', respectively. Thus, the name Heinrike can be translated as 'gracious strength' or 'merciful might'. in_greek.name: Ειρήνη
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the word ειρήνη (eirēnē), meaning 'peace'. This name was popular among the ancient Greeks as a symbol of peace and tranquility. It is also the name of the Greek goddess of peace, Eirene. The name Heinrike may be derived from the Greek name Eirene, as the German name Heike or Heidrun is believed to be derived from the Old Norse name Hjördís, which is also derived from the Old Norse word hjör, meaning 'peace'. Thus, the name Heinrike can be seen as a fusion of the German and Greek traditions, representing both 'gracious strength' and 'peace'.

in_latin.name: Hilaria
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the word hilaris, meaning 'cheerful' or 'joyful'. This name was used in ancient Rome to describe a happy and lively person. The name Heinrike may be derived from the Latin name Hilaria, as the German name Heidrun is believed to be derived from the Old Norse name Hjördís, which is also related to the Old English word hēoru, meaning 'joy' or 'delight'. Thus, the name Heinrike can be seen as a fusion of the German and Latin traditions, representing both 'gracious strength' and 'joy'.

in_english.name: Heinrike
in_english.long_meaning: A name of German origin, derived from the Old High German words hein, meaning 'one' or 'he', and rik, meaning 'ruler' or 'mighty'. The name Heinrike can be translated as 'ruler of the gracious' or 'ruler of the merciful'. It is also a variant of the name Henrike, which is derived from the Old High German name Heinerike, a compound of the words hein and rike. The name Heinrike is a feminine name and is not directly related to any biblical name.
